summary: Fullstack developer with nearly 7 years of experience building banking, SaaS, and AI applications across the stack, from React frontends and REST APIs to cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and internal developer tooling.

bullets: Designed and implemented internal services and self-hosted solutions supporting engineering and operational workflows.
Built internal developer tools and reusable services to standardize workflows, automate tasks, and improve productivity.
Developed internal AI tools and products, integrating LLMs and automated workflows into business and engineering use cases.
Contributed to proprietary AI IP, exploring and productizing AI capabilities into reusable solutions and internal platforms.
Deployed and operated on-premise and self-hosted services, handling configuration, networking, monitoring, and maintenance.
Built and managed **AWS** resources (EC2, S3, IAM) to host internal services and support engineering workflows.
Collaborated with engineering teams to turn infrastructure, tooling, and AI opportunities into maintainable solutions.

Led two **scalable end-to-end production systems**—a call analysis SaaS platform and a trading card marketplace API—owning architecture, frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure from design through deployment and day-to-day operation.
Built AI-driven transcription and insight pipelines for call centers.
Adopted **AI-driven development** workflows with tools like **Claude Code** to accelerate feature delivery and code review.
Delivered gamification features (leaderboards, achievements) to drive user engagement.
Built REST API for trading card marketplace aggregating multi-source pricing data.
Designed automated ingestion pipelines, search indexing, and cron-based synchronization.
Managed **cloud services on GCP** with **Terraform** and **CI/CD pipelines**, including automated testing and monitoring.
Collaborated with leadership to design and automate the HR system infrastructure, eliminating tens of hours of weekly reporting.
Developed reusable **internal tools** and libraries with standardized interfaces, streamlining development and reducing boilerplate.
Built secure login for a cross-platform mobile banking app—challenge authentication, OTP login, and **session management**.

Rebuilt legacy banking **REST API** services spanning over 200 endpoints, and modernized legacy browser and mobile banking applications using **Angular/Ionic** and **Express** frameworks to meet evolving system requirements.
Implemented **state management** using **Redux** to maintain consistency and performance across the banking frontend.
Established test environments and wrote **unit** and **end-to-end** tests to meet the banking client's **90% test coverage** requirement.
Provided **technical leadership** to team members through training and ongoing developer support on the banking application team.
Built a **reusable global component library** in **Storybook** with UI designers, improving consistency across banking applications.
**Saved QA teams hundreds of hours weekly** with **Python** scripts that parse phone IVR banking logs, replacing manual searches.
Built a **React** real estate proof of concept, designing the UI architecture and leading the team's design patterns.
Worked in **Agile** teams to define and implement user stories and tasks across client engagements.
Open source maintainer of **11 applications**, **5 API services**, **7 Docker images** and **4 npm packages**.

Design and run **agentic coding workflows** with **Claude Code**, building custom skills and slash commands for code review, refactor cleanup, documentation upkeep, and automated PR authoring that run consistently across Claude Code and Codex.
Provision and operate **cloud infrastructure** with **Terraform**, managing secrets through dedicated secret managers.
Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for PR checks, health checks, cron jobs, and smoke, end-to-end, and security tests.
